correctness.rationale: Verified d≥2, k≥0, exact homogeneous Euclidean harmonics and complexification. Fourier character support j≤k follows coordinate factor-count; k=1 has centered mean zero and k=2 harmonic mean zero by isotropic second moment. For j≥2 construct holomorphic/antiholomorphic monomials in j distinct complex coordinates with positive exponents not divisible by 3 summing k; each monomial is harmonic. The remaining j=0,1 modes are detected using Fischer decomposition P_k=H_k⊕Q P_{k−2} and explicit nonzero coefficients on Q=0: (k²−9k+16)/(4(k−2)!) and (2−k)/(k−1)!; check integer discriminant 17 ensures first is never zero. Fourier averaging isolates characters. Addition formula makes the normalized Gegenbauer kernel a PSD sampling Gram and diagonalizes it via shell Krawtchouk transform. Independent exact rational computation of 462 (d,k,j) levels (2≤d≤7, 0≤k≤13) found all stated signs. These finite checks corroborate, while all-degree proof is analytic.

value.rationale: The full Cartesian ternary Clifford grid is natural and highly symmetric, and exact-degree harmonic interpolation is a stricter and structurally different question from polynomial-degree ≤k interpolation. Exact rank support in every degree, restored constant mode from k=3 and the sharp simultaneous interpolation threshold are reusable facts for sampling/cubature on product spherical configurations.

limitations: Only equally normalized three-point circles, d≥2; no stability/condition-number theorem or other alphabets.
